Added createPreviousLink(), createNextLink(), createPageLink(), createEllipsis(), createPageJumpInput() protected helpers in BaseGridRenderer.

comments.note: Bootstrap5Renderer helper methods (createBootstrapPaginationRow, etc.) are private which is correct, but the class currently has no @internal annotation. For library code, consider adding @internal to private implementation helpers or keeping them protected to allow downstream extension.

createPageJumpInput() and createBootstrapPageJumpInput() both inline the URL template directly into JS: '{$urlTemplate}'.replace('{PAGE}', p). If the URL template contains single quotes this will break the JS string. Escaping or using a data attribute would be safer.
No observations on HTML structure — all pagination elements use HTMLTag correctly with no string concatenation.

summary: All 12 acceptance criteria verified against source code. PHPStan level 6 confirms zero errors on all 3 modified files (GridRendererInterface.php, BaseGridRenderer.php, Bootstrap5Renderer.php). Both renderers correctly early-return empty on no-provider / single-page. Active page renders as span in both. Ellipsis structure confirmed per-renderer. Bootstrap5Renderer has correct nav/ul.pagination/li.page-item/a.page-link nesting with aria-label. Jump-to-page confirmed for both renderers. URL template with {PAGE} sentinel confirmed in JS. All HTML via HTMLTag, strict_types present in all files.

comments.note: JavaScript .replace('{PAGE}', p) in createPageJumpInput() and createBootstrapPageJumpInput() only replaces the first occurrence of '{PAGE}'. For the current URL template usage this is fine, but if a URL ever contains multiple {PAGE} tokens only the first would be substituted. JS replaceAll() would be safer.

The URL template is interpolated directly into a JS string literal via double-quoted PHP string. If getPageURLTemplate() returns a URL containing a single quote, the JS string will be syntactically broken. No sanitisation or escaping is applied. Consider JSON-encoding the template string before embedding it in JS.
Bootstrap5Renderer correctly uses private visibility for pagination helpers since the base class uses protected helpers — this is a deliberate design choice. No action needed.

summary: All 12 acceptance criteria confirmed met. PHPStan level 6 reports zero errors on all three modified files (GridRendererInterface.php, BaseGridRenderer.php, Bootstrap5Renderer.php). Both renderers correctly early-return for no-provider / single-page; active page renders as span; ellipsis and disabled prev/next render correctly in both renderers; Bootstrap 5 nav/ul.pagination/li.page-item/a.page-link structure is correct; jump-to-page present in both renderers; all HTML via HTMLTag; strict_types=1 in all files.

One high-priority concern: $urlTemplate is interpolated raw into a JS single-quoted string in both createPageJumpInput() implementations — a URL containing a single quote will break the inline JS. Should be fixed with json_encode() before production use. Three low-priority accessibility and robustness notes also raised.

comments.note: createPageJumpInput() in BaseGridRenderer.php and createBootstrapPageJumpInput() in Bootstrap5Renderer.php both interpolate $urlTemplate directly into a JS single-quoted string literal: window.location.href = '{$urlTemplate}'.replace('{PAGE}', p). If getPageURLTemplate() ever returns a URL containing a single quote (e.g. a query param like it%27s or a path with an apostrophe in a slug), the inline JS string will be syntactically broken and throw a JS error. Fix with json_encode(): window.location.href = " . json_encode($urlTemplate) . ".replaceAll('{PAGE}', p);

Both createPageJumpInput() and createBootstrapPageJumpInput() use JS .replace('{PAGE}', p) which only substitutes the first occurrence. .replaceAll() is semantically correct here and more defensive against contrived edge-case URL templates.

Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageItem() does not add aria-current="page" to the active <li> or inner <span>. WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1 and Bootstrap 5 docs both recommend this for screen-reader accessibility on pagination components.

createBootstrapPreviousItem() and createBootstrapNextItem() render « / » as visible text without a text alternative (no aria-label on the <a> or <li>). Screen readers will announce the entity character name or skip it. Adding aria-label="Previous page" / aria-label="Next page" on the <a>/<li> would improve accessibility.
HTMLTag::setContent() confirmed to not HTML-escape its input (raw add via string builder). The entity strings «, », … render correctly in the browser. No action needed — confirming safe pattern.

Duplication between createPaginationRow()/helpers in BaseGridRenderer and createBootstrapPaginationRow()/helpers in Bootstrap5Renderer is structurally justified by the divergent HTML output. Private visibility on Bootstrap helpers is correct and prevents unintended override. No action needed.
